name: Arrows
description: Standard arrows used with shortbows and longbows for ordinary ranged combat.
narrative_effects: Required to use compatible bows for ordinary ranged attacks.
Some fired arrows may be recoverable depending on impact, terrain, and scene outcome.

name: Bolts
description: Standard crossbow bolts used with light and heavy crossbows.
narrative_effects: Required to use compatible crossbows for ordinary ranged attacks.
Some fired bolts may be recoverable depending on impact, terrain, and scene outcome.

name: Sling Stones
description: Smooth stone ammunition sized for practical sling use.
narrative_effects: Required to use a sling effectively at range.
Spent sling stones are usually treated as lost, scattered, or not worth recovering individually.

name: Blowgun Needles
description: Light blowgun needles intended for quiet projectile use.
narrative_effects: Required to use a blowgun effectively.
Spent needles are usually lost, bent, or impractical to recover in useful quantity.

name: Broadhead Arrows
description: Wide-bladed arrows built for hunting and soft-target lethality rather than armor penetration.
narrative_effects: Supports stronger bleeding or flesh-wound framing against unarmored or lightly protected targets.
May be recoverable if not badly bent or lodged.

name: Bodkin Arrows
description: Narrow hardened arrows designed to better threaten armor gaps and tougher targets.
narrative_effects: Supports armor-pressuring or armor-gap attack framing where shot placement is credible.
May be recoverable if not shattered or deeply buried.

name: Fire Arrows
description: Prepared arrows intended to carry flame into vulnerable materials, structures, or exposed targets.
narrative_effects: Supports ignition and fire-delivery framing through compatible bows.
Usually destroyed or rendered unusable after firing.

name: Frost Arrows
description: Arrows prepared with alchemical or magical frost charge for chilling impact effects.
narrative_effects: Supports chill, brittle-surface, or slowing-impact framing where frost effects are plausible.
Usually loses its prepared charge once fired.

name: Signal Arrows
description: Specialized arrows designed for visible signaling, noise, or marking rather than battlefield lethality.
narrative_effects: Supports signaling, marking, or long-distance nonverbal coordination.
Usually expended in the act of signaling rather than recovered for reuse.

name: Rope Arrows
description: Heavy arrowheads designed to carry and anchor light climbing line or signaling cord.
narrative_effects: Supports line-placement or difficult elevated anchoring where conditions allow.
May be recoverable if the anchor holds and the head remains intact.

name: Broadhead Bolts
description: Heavy broadhead bolts intended for hunting and soft-target lethality.
narrative_effects: Supports stronger bleeding or flesh-wound framing against unarmored or lightly protected targets.
May be recoverable if not badly damaged on impact.

name: Bodkin Bolts
description: Narrow reinforced bolts built to better threaten armor seams and tougher defensive targets.
narrative_effects: Supports armor-pressure framing where a heavy penetrating shot is plausible.
May be recoverable if not ruined by the impact.

name: Fire Bolts
description: Prepared crossbow bolts carrying incendiary charge for controlled ignition or destructive strike delivery.
narrative_effects: Supports ignition and fire-delivery framing through compatible crossbows.
Usually destroyed or stripped of special function after firing.

name: Frost Bolts
description: Charged bolts intended to deliver chilling force or brittle-impact pressure on contact.
narrative_effects: Supports frost-infused impact, chilling pressure, or brittle-material framing.
Usually loses its prepared charge once fired.

name: Blessed Bolts
description: Consecrated bolts prepared for use in rites of sanctioned violence against profane or corrupted threats.
narrative_effects: Supports sacred-pressure framing where holy authority is recognized and relevant.
Typically treated as ritually expended whether physically recoverable or not.

name: Weighted Sling Stones
description: Dense selected stones or shaped pellets intended to hit harder than ordinary sling ammunition.
narrative_effects: Supports stronger blunt-impact framing than ordinary sling stones.
Usually treated as spent, scattered, or not worth recovering one by one.

name: Sling Firepots
description: Fragile sling-fired incendiary capsules intended to shatter and ignite on impact.
narrative_effects: Supports small-scale ignition, distraction, or fire-setting through sling delivery.
Destroyed on use.

name: Poisoned Blowgun Needles
description: Prepared blowgun needles carrying toxin for quiet delivery where subtle harm matters more than force.
narrative_effects: Supports toxin-delivery framing through stealth-oriented ranged attacks.
Treated as expended once fired whether the needle survives or not.

name: Sleep Needles
description: Specialized sedative-treated needles meant for subdual, capture, or quiet takedown attempts.
narrative_effects: Supports sleep, sedation, or subdual framing where delivery and dosage are plausible.
Treated as expended after use.

name: Marking Needles
description: Special needles designed to deliver dye, scent marker, or similar tagging payloads rather than direct harm.
narrative_effects: Supports marking, tracking, or identification framing against unaware or fleeing targets.
Treated as expended once delivered.
